resources.string: Tap each item to open its setting. A check appears when Android allows access. You can continue whenever you want.
Alarms and notifications are allowed. Also review your battery and device settings.
Some access is pending. Review the items below or continue and adjust them later in Settings.
Lock screen and windows: reviewed by you
Enable notifications, alarm alerts and follow-up reminders to keep track of your doses.
Review notifications, alarm alerts and reminders
Exact alarm access allows alerts at your chosen time, even with the screen off.
Allow full-screen alarms to show the complete card, with the medication and actions, while the device is locked. Android controls when the card opens.
In the battery optimization list, select DoseCerta and allow it to run without optimization. On Xiaomi, also check that app battery saver is set to No restrictions.
Select DoseCerta in the app list and choose Don’t optimize.
Battery optimization is active: review this setting
In DoseCerta app info, allow Autostart. Depending on the version, you can find it under Settings › Apps › Permissions › Background autostart.
In DoseCerta app info, open Other permissions. Allow Show on Lock screen and Open new windows while running in the background, when these options are available.
These checks only save your own review. DoseCerta cannot verify manufacturer authorizations.
Vibration, alarm playback, waking the screen and restoring reminders after a restart are authorized by Android when installed. They require no additional confirmation.
